verdict.rationale: Dagster's code-as-assets model implies pipelines live in version control (Python code, dg CLI scaffolding), and changelog/asset-check evidence shows some historical tracking of automation conditions, but there is no direct documentation of a UI-driven versioning/review/rollback workflow for automations themselves (e.g., run history rollback, approval workflows, diffing automation changes). missing for 10: explicit rollback mechanism for automations, review/approval workflow for changes, dedicated versioning UI beyond code diffs in git, independent evidence of these features being used in practice.
